content.introduction: Oil prices jumped by over 4%, while shares on the Kospi fell 9%, as SK Hynix shares sank by over 15% on another mixed day for Asian markets. SK Hynix IPO reinvigorated AI trade, boosting Asia stocks. Meanwhile, India is likely exporting refined Russian oil to the West. In the Asian financial markets, the Nikkei 225, Hang Seng, S&P/ASX 200, and Nifty 50 indices showed gains, with the Hang Seng rising by 1.00% and the S&P/ASX 200 by 0.61%.
